name: Auto MPG
description: Vehicle attributes, missing horsepower, origin, and city-cycle fuel economy.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.attribution: Quinlan, R. (1993). Auto MPG [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5859H.

learning_goals: Inspect residuals across model years and origins.
Contrast linear, neighbour, and boosted-tree regressors.
ethical_notes: Historical city-cycle estimates are not comparable to current regulatory tests and should not guide modern purchase or emissions claims.
